newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol retail share offer price set at 5,803 ptas.
newsitem.headline: Repsol retail share offer price set at 5,803 ptas.

text.p: Spain's Repsol said on Monday the price for the retail tranche of its public share offering had been set at 5,803 pesetas.
The price for the institutional tranche has been set at 6,010 pesetas.

The retail price was fixed by applying a four percent discount to the average weighted price of the stock as traded in Madrid on Monday. This was the lowest of three options for the retail offer, as established in the share prospectus.
Repsol shares closed down 70 pesetas at 6,010 on Monday.
This is the end of the privatisation of the energy group, with state holding company SEPI now having sold its remaining 10 percent.
